INSERT INTO edudoc_format_rule (id, template_version_id, rule_type, target_selector, severity, auto_fixable, rule_config_json, rule_order)
SELECT HEXTORAW(#{rule.id}), HEXTORAW(#{rule.templateVersionId}), #{rule.ruleType}, #{rule.targetSelector}, #{rule.severity}, #{rule.autoFixable}, CAST(#{rule.ruleConfigJson} AS JSON), #{rule.ruleOrder} FROM DUAL
mapper.select: SELECT RAWTOHEX(r.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(r.template_version_id) AS templateVersionId, r.rule_type AS ruleType, r.target_selector AS targetSelector, r.severity, r.auto_fixable AS autoFixable, JSON_SERIALIZE(r.rule_config_json RETURNING VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ruleConfigJson, r.rule_order AS ruleOrder FROM edudoc_format_rule r WHERE r.id IN HEXTORAW(#{id})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM edudoc_format_rule WHERE template_version_id = HEXTORAW(#{versionId})
mapper.select: SELECT RAWTOHEX(r.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(r.template_version_id) AS templateVersionId, r.rule_type AS ruleType, r.target_selector AS targetSelector, r.severity, r.auto_fixable AS autoFixable, JSON_SERIALIZE(r.rule_config_json RETURNING VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ruleConfigJson, r.rule_order AS ruleOrder FROM edudoc_format_rule r WHERE r.template_version_id = HEXTORAW(#{versionId}) ORDER BY r.rule_order, r.create_time
